title: Microsoft Edge: v.144 - Performance settings update and feature name changes
description: Efficiency mode feature name will change to energy saver and efficiency mode for PC gaming name will be renamed PC gaming boost to better describe the feature benefits.  The new names will be in browser performance settings after the update.
